exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: philosophy majors staging a quiet comeback in tech discourse
forbidden books finding a new public shelf in portugal
san francisco summer under a gray marine layer
long july evenings — sunset still past eight
stutter-house pulses drifting through overcast headphones

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Tap on the stutter-house beat to push a marine layer back and reveal golden sun shafts over SF hills before the fog rolls in again.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: Perfect streaks peel back fog layers to expose a brighter skyline silhouette.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: BPM climbs and off-beat windows shrink as wind picks up.
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: hazy watercolor hills with neon pulse rings on each hit

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Sort falling book spines into three shelves — allowed, whispered, forbidden — before the stack topples.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Clean sorting chains unlock rare gilt titles that flash on the shelf.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Pages fall faster and ambiguous spines blur between categories.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: Portuguese azulejo tiles and paper cutout book spines

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw branching argument paths connecting premise nodes to conclusion orbits — dead-end syllogisms dissolve.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: Elegant proofs bloom as constellation logic trees when every node links cleanly.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: More premises spawn and contradictory nodes appear mid-round.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: chalkboard constellation with glowing syllogism arcs

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick dew droplets up through overcast layers to catch brief sun pockets before they evaporate.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Droplets that reach the light burst into short summer color flashes.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Wind shear curves trajectories and fewer valid sun pockets stay open.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: muted gray-blue glass beads with burst gradient pops
